detail: Available release is a warped 512x512 grayscale derivative. Original 100-scene RGBNIR/SAR/land-use labels and geographic coverage cannot be certified from it.
Patch IDs do not identify source scenes. Source-scene independence and spatial train/test leakage remain unverified.
6300/6300 pairs lack CRS/geotransform. Coverage limited to pixel extent and synthetic-flow overlap.
